wants.what: to see his younger brother Su Zhe again

because.what: their posts kept them far apart, and the full moon of the festival for families found them apart

becomes.what: he takes the waxing and waning moon as the way of things and wishes them the same moon from far apart

record.story: On the Mid-Autumn night of 1076, posted in Mizhou, Su Shi drank until dawn missing his younger brother Su Zhe, whom he had not seen for years, and wrote 水调歌头: the moon waxes and wanes as people part and meet, and he wishes only that they live long and share the moon from a thousand li apart.
sources: 苏轼《水调歌头·明月几时有》及小序：丙辰中秋，欢饮达旦，大醉，作此篇，兼怀子由。

materials.assets/page-turn.mp3: the pages of the moon book turning: the month going by from a new moon to the Mid-Autumn full moon the poem was written under

leave: The moon waxes and wanes, and a flip book can hold a whole month of it.

device.what: a hand-drawn flip book, one moon phase per page, turned twice a beat
device.why: a month of moon phases is a slow change that a riffled book shows in a few seconds
